visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long wavy hair and a dark t-shirt stands in a bright indoor living room, holding a large cup of instant noodles. He talks energetically towards the camera, using wide hand gestures. The background shows a grey sofa and a white lamp. Yellow and white text overlays appear at the top and bottom. (2) The camera focuses on a close-up of the noodle cup. Hands open seasoning packets and pour dark sauce and dried vegetables over the circular noodle block. Steaming hot water is poured from a silver kettle into the bowl. The lighting is bright and direct. (3) The man is shown again, now eating the prepared noodles with black chopsticks. He takes a large bite, and his eyes widen in an exaggerated expression of taste. Close-up shots show the noodles being lifted, coated in a thick, dark red chili sauce with visible bits of cabbage. (4) In a close-up, thick white coconut milk is poured from a small carton onto the center of the stir-fry noodles. This is followed by a sprinkle of crushed brown peanuts and fresh green cilantro leaves. The man takes another bite, nodding and gesturing to indicate the deliciousness of the combination. (5) The person uses a pair of metal scissors to cut strips of cooked white chicken breast directly over the bowl. The noodles are then shown in a high-detail close-up, glistening with oil and cream. The man holds his hand out in a 'stop' motion while chewing, looking overwhelmed by the flavor. (6) The man stands in front of a plain background, holding two different versions of the '味味A' noodle cups towards the lens. He continues talking with a smile, encouraging the audience. The video ends with a montage of the prepared dish and the product packaging.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 炒泡麵隱藏吃法. [Slogan]: 川香椒麻炒泡麵. [Logo]: 味味A. [Variety]: 椰漿. (2) [Subtitle]: 先準備味味A炒泡麵. (3) [Subtitle]: 打開佐料包. 加入熱水沖泡. (4) [Subtitle]: 拌入川香椒麻辣醬. (5) [Subtitle]: 花椒的麻直接沾附在麵體上面. 麻跟辣的衝勁. (6) [Subtitle]: 你咬到那個蔬菜還會爆發出一點清甜. 這泡麵裡面是有肉跟菜的. (7) [Subtitle]: 我們這種愛重口味吃到是受不了. 但是我還有隱藏吃法. (8) [Subtitle]: 準備椰漿拌入炒泡麵. 撒上花生碎粒+香菜. (9) [Slogan]: 南洋風增添一個麻辣層次. [Variety]: 一秒變成南洋椰香辣麵. (10) [Subtitle]: 前面有椰奶香鋪墊. 最後來個極大的反差. (11) [Subtitle]: 麻辣味衝上來. [Variety]: 超級好吃. (12) [Subtitle]: 加上超商買的雞胸肉. 把它剪成絲鋪上去. [Variety]: 太好吃了吧. (13) [Subtitle]: 雞肉香氣會引領更多辣醬風味出來. (14) [Logo]: 味味A. [Slogan]: 川香椒麻. 全通路都有販售. 爆香三杯.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male narrator begins speaking in Mandarin with a clear, enunciated broadcast quality. Background music (BGM) in an upbeat pop-rock style featuring driving drum beats and bright synthesizer chords starts immediately. (2) At the 7-second mark, a distinct splashing sound of boiling water being poured into a bowl is heard. The narrator continues his fast-paced description while the BGM remains constant in volume and tempo. (3) A prominent, wet slurping sound occurs around 0:12, followed by a brief satisfied vocalization from the narrator. The music's rhythm is steady with a strong snare drum hit, maintaining forward momentum. (4) Rapid, metallic clicking sounds of scissors cutting through chicken are heard around 0:45. The narrator's voice swells in intensity and loudness as he expresses joy. (5) The speaker concludes with a rising intonation, inviting the audience to try the noodles. The BGM fades out with a final rhythmic hit, showing high production quality with studio-clean vocals.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Product Preparation -> Taste Test -> Variant Suggestion -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a creative culinary promotion for '味味A' brand stir-fry noodles. It uses an energetic vlog-style format to demonstrate the product's preparation and then introduces a unique 'hidden' recipe involving coconut milk and chicken breast to enhance the flavor. The goal is to drive consumer interest by showcasing the product's versatility and deliciousness through high-arousal expressions.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator prominently displays the brand '味味A' noodles throughout the video and provides a specific recipe to promote them.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The high visual and audio energy combined with the 'hidden recipe' trope effectively targets social media users interested in food hacks and quick meals.
